# `sensitive-params`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

Tools should not ask agents for credentials or payment secrets; collect those through the page UI instead.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option    | Default   |
| --------- | --------- |
| `pattern` | see below |

<details>
<summary><code>pattern</code> default</summary>

```json
"(password|passcode|secret|token|api[-_]?key|ssn|social[-_]?security|credit[-_]?card|card[-_]?number|cvv|cvc|iban|account[-_]?number|routing)"
```

</details>

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "sensitive-params": false } });          // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "sensitive-params": "warning" } });      // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "sensitive-params": { pattern: /* see the table above */ } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule sensitive-params=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/sensitive-params": "error" } }
```
